enum.name: DCLINK_RESULT
enum.description: Result of a DCLink control request.

enum.name: DCLINK_NAVIGATION_TYPE
enum.description: Navigation source currently used by DCLink.

enum.name: DCLINK_TARGET_STATUS
enum.description: Target state visible to DCLink commands.

enum.name: DCLINK_PARAMETER_ACCESS_ROLE
enum.description: Operator roles advertised by command and parameter catalog metadata.

enum.name: DCLINK_MISSION_TRANSFER_RESULT
enum.description: Transfer outcome, independent of the logical mission service result.

message.name: DCLINK_STATUS
message.field: Client request id copied into the response.
Autopilot connection state.
Detected autopilot type.
Active command id; 0 means no running command.
Active command name; empty or idle means no running command.
Current command runtime state.
Current navigation source.
Current navigation health/status.
Current target status.
Logging state.
Reserved status bitmask.

message.name: DCLINK_COMMAND
message.description: List, start, stop, or acknowledge a DCLink command.
message.field: Client request id copied into the response.
Requested action or response action.
Action result for ACK/ERROR responses.
Total available commands for list responses.
Command id; 0 is the command-list root for GET.
Command machine name, for example hold or copter/takeoff.
Human-readable command label.
UI/group section, for example main or copter.
Reserved command capability bitmask.
Roles allowed to access this command. Zero means unspecified metadata.

message.name: DCLINK_PARAMETER
message.description: List, set, or acknowledge a DCLink runtime parameter.
message.field: Client request id copied into the response.
Requested action or response action.
Action result for ACK/ERROR responses.
Total available parameters for list responses.
Parameter id; 0 is the parameter-list root for GET.
Parameter key/name.
Parameter value encoded as UTF-8 text.
UI/group section, for example core, safety, or navigation.
Reserved parameter bitmask.
Roles allowed to access this parameter. Zero means unspecified metadata.

message.name: DCLINK_TARGET_VIEW
message.description: Read-only selected runtime target. Query: every field zero except request_id. Reply: schema_version=1. Validity flags govern all geometry; zero is never an unavailable sentinel. Angles require no range or GPS. Replies do not establish service liveness.
message.field: Independent read correlation ID; never reused within a client lifetime.
Random nonzero endpoint lifetime identity.
Increasing reply sequence within boot_id.
Independent validity and target state bits.
Age of selected observation on receipt at DCLink.
Measurement age when SOURCE_AGE is set.
Remaining target lifetime at reply creation, at most 3000 ms. Client subtracts full query round trip.
Aircraft-relative nose azimuth, positive right, wrapped to [-180,180].
Body-frame line-of-sight elevation, positive up, [-90,90].
Horizontal range estimate; never slant range.
Target latitude in WGS84 degrees.
Target longitude in WGS84 degrees.
Target minus aircraft north offset in local NED.
Target minus aircraft east offset in local NED.
Zero for query, one for reply.
Aircraft associated with the runtime observation.
Aircraft component associated with the runtime observation.
Reported runtime control authority, independent of active command.
Range provenance, independent of angle validity.
Selected track ID if supplied; empty means unknown. UTF-8.
Selected observation source if supplied; empty means unknown. UTF-8.

message.name: DCLINK_MISSION_REQUEST
message.description: Addressed mission RPC transfer request. The complete wire profile is defined in missions/mavlink.md. Only BEGIN, COMMIT, READ and ABORT are request stages.
message.field: Mission transfer protocol version, currently 1.
Destination system; zero broadcasts are not accepted.
Destination component; zero broadcasts are not accepted.
DCLink boot UUID in RFC 4122 byte order; all zero only for discovery.
Client process UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Logical operation UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Client-assigned transfer UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Requested transfer stage.
BEGIN and ABORT: zero; COMMIT: complete upload length; READ: requested reply byte offset.
BEGIN and COMMIT: complete upload length; otherwise zero.
BEGIN and COMMIT: SHA-256 of exact upload bytes; otherwise all zero.

message.name: DCLINK_MISSION_RESULT
message.description: Addressed mission RPC transfer acknowledgement or error. COMMIT success describes the immutable logical JSON reply, whose own result determines operation success.
message.field: Mission transfer protocol version, currently 1.
Destination client system.
Destination client component.
Current actual DCLink boot UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Echoed client process UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Echoed logical operation UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Echoed transfer UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Acknowledged request stage, or CHUNK for uploaded DATA.
BEGIN and CHUNK success: next upload offset; COMMIT success: zero.
BEGIN and CHUNK success: upload length; COMMIT success: reply length; otherwise zero.
BEGIN and CHUNK success: upload digest; COMMIT success: reply digest; otherwise all zero.
Transfer outcome, not the logical service result.

message.name: DCLINK_MISSION_DATA
message.description: Addressed mission RPC bytes. Client uploads are acknowledged by RESULT CHUNK; server replies to READ contain an immutable logical reply slice. Only data_length bytes are meaningful, including trailing zero bytes.
message.field: Mission transfer protocol version, currently 1.
Destination system; zero broadcasts are not accepted.
Destination component; zero broadcasts are not accepted.
DCLink boot UUID in RFC 4122 byte order; all zero only during discovery upload.
Client process UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Logical operation UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Transfer UUID in RFC 4122 byte order.
Byte offset of this slice in its complete upload or reply.
Number of meaningful data bytes, from 1 through 160.
Exact bytes followed by zero padding; use data_length after MAVLink 2 zero restoration.
